svg.title: The search dialog in flow.mjs
svg.desc: flow.mjs signs in as e2e-user, opens the personal settings and the search, types mobiletest and adds the connected services, with the switch of Nextcloud 33 and 34 or the button of Nextcloud 35. It expects the group Paperless documents with only Mobile viewer test, read out with its title, its date and its excerpt as text. A click on the result opens the file in Files, in the Viewer, which names it in its header. It does this on a laptop and then on a phone.
